with reference to the attached translation of a report entitled "Formation of a Newspaper Circles' Lien Nyi Association" (新聞界聯誼會) published by the "Ta Mei Pao" (大美報) of December 9, C.A. Loh Sih-kya has elicited the following information :-

Prior to the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities in Shanghai in 1937 there were in existence in Shanghai two Chinese journalists' organizations namely :-

(1) The Shanghai Newspaper Owners' Association which was formed by eight local Chinese language dailies to which mosquito papers were not admitted as members. The office of this association was located in the premises of the "Shun Pao" (申報), No. 309 Hankow Road.

(2) The Shanghai Journalists' Association which was established by members of the editorial staff of various local dailies. The editors and reporters of mosquito papers and news agencies were allowed to join this body, the office of which was located in the Continental Emporium Building, Nanking Road.

These two organizations, however, ceased to function after the withdrawal of the Chinese forces from Shanghai.

Recently the Chinese members of the editorial staff of the "Hwa Mei Wan Pao" (華美晚報) and the "Hwa Mei Chen Pao" (華美晨報) of which Mr.H.P.Mills is the publisher, adopted a hostile attitude towards their colleagues of the "Ta Mei Wan Pao" (大美晚報) and the "Ta Mei Pao" (大美報), denouncing the latter's attitude towards their country. 关于附译的题为《新闻界联谊会的成立》（新聞界聯誼會）的报告，该报告刊登于12月9日的《大美报》（Ta Mei Pao），C.A. Loh Sih-kya 已获取以下信息：-

在1937年上海中日敌对行动爆发之前，上海存在两个中国记者组织，即：-

(1) 上海报业公会，由八家本地中文日报组成，小报不被接纳为会员。该会办事处位于汉口路309号《申报》（Shun Pao）馆内。

(2) 上海记者协会，由各家本地日报的编辑人员建立。小报及通讯社的编辑和记者被允许加入该团体，其办事处位于南京路大陆商场大楼。

然而，在中国军队撤离上海后，这两个组织便停止了运作。

最近，由 H.P. Mills 先生出版的《华美晚报》（Hwa Mei Wan Pao）和《华美晨报》（Hwa Mei Chen Pao）的中方编辑人员对其《大美晚报》（Ta Mei Wan Pao）和《大美报》（Ta Mei Pao）的同事采取了敌对态度，谴责后两家报纸对其国家的态度。后两家报纸的中方经理张似旭先生（Chang Sz-hsu，張似旭），

Ta Mei Pao:

FORMATION OF A NEWSPAPER CIRCLES LIEN NYI ASSOCIATION

In the past there were, in local newspaper circles, two bodies known as the Newspaper Owners' Association and the Reporters' Association. The former body was an organization of capitalists, with the "Shun Pao" (申報), the "Sin Wan Pao" (新聞報), the "Ta Kung Pao" (大公報), the "China Times" (時事新報), the "Min Pao" (民報), the "Eastern Times" (時報) and the "Lih Pao" (立報) as members. Following the withdrawal of Chinese troops from Shanghai, the "Shun Pao", the "Ta Kung Pao", the "China Times" and the "Lih Pao" removed away from Shanghai to continue publication, whereupon the Newspaper Owners' Association was immediately dissolved.

The Reporters' Association located at the Continental Emporium Building is an organization of newspaper employees, with a membership of 300. The expenses of the Association are very high. Recently, owing to arrears in house rents, the landlord cancelled the lease and sold the furniture by auction. Thus, there is no Reporters' Association in existence at present.

Most of the leading newspapers are now operating under foreign registration. However, both the capitalists and the employees lack an organization.

As a result of preparations extending over a period of several months, a body known as the Newspaper Circles Lien Nyi Association has been inaugurated by members of .. newspaper circles, with Chui Shao-yi (瞿紹伊), Wong Vee-tseng (汪維楨), Chang Sz-hsu (張似旭), Nien Pao-li (嚴宝禮) and 7 others as members of the Board of Management.
page_data.zh:
《大美报》：

新闻界联谊会的成立

过去，本地新闻界有两个团体，分别称为报业公会和记者协会。前者是一个资本家的组织，成员包括《申报》（Shun Pao）、《新闻报》（Sin Wan Pao）、《大公报》（Ta Kung Pao）、《时事新报》（China Times）、《民报》（Min Pao）、《时报》（Eastern Times）和《立报》（Lih Pao）。随着中国军队从上海撤离，《申报》、《大公报》、《时事新报》和《立报》迁出上海继续出版，随即报业公会立即解散。

位于大陆商场大楼的记者协会是一个报纸雇员组织，拥有300名会员。该协会的开支非常高。最近，由于拖欠房租，房东取消了租约并通过拍卖出售了家具。因此，目前不存在记者协会。

大多数主要报纸现在都在外国注册下运营。然而，无论是资本家还是雇员都缺乏一个组织。

经过数月的筹备，一个名为新闻界联谊会的团体由..新闻界人士 inaugurated（成立），管理董事会成员包括瞿紹伊（Chui Shao-yi）、汪維楨（Wong Vee-tseng）、张似旭（Chang Sz-hsu）、嚴宝禮（Nien Pao-li）及其他7人。

Translation of French Police Report
No. 2957/1 dated October 14, 1938.

Subject: Establishment of a journalists' club.

The larger Shanghai newspapers, under Japanese
pressure, are said to have been considering creating an
"Intellectual Circles' Friendly Association" (文化界聯歡會)
with the object of establishing closer contact among
themselves and of protecting their mutual interests.
The organisers, however, showing very little zeal and
with the Japanese trying to win over certain
journalists to their cause, the association has been
unable to be established.

Following this check, Chang Tse Yeu (張翰),
reporter from the "Ta Mei Pao" and Chang Che Shao
(張似旭), manager of the "Ta Mei Pao" (the latter
has lost his influence since this paper was placed
under the administration of the British publication of
the same name), inspired by the desire of securing
therefrom personal advantages, took the initiative to
organise a "journalists' club."

They succeeded in rallying together certain
members of the Nationalist Government, journalists and
newspaper editors, and attempted to obtain a subsidy
from the National Government. The Club was to have been
located at the office of Mr. Chang Fah Yao (張法),
a lawyer, Chung Wei Building, 16 Rue Porte du Nord.

The Club, in exerting its efforts to direct the
policy of newspapers, greatly pleased the National
Government. However, the newspaper men, being indignant
at the activities of the two promoters, refused to
belong to the Club. The attitude of the Ta Mei Pao
became suspicious following the news of a voyage to
Japan for an unknown cause, made by Mr. R. GOULD, chief

1938年10月14日第2957/1号法国警察报告译文。

主题：记者俱乐部的建立。

据称，在上海较大的报纸在日本的
压力下，一直在考虑创建一个
“文化界联欢会”（Intellectual Circles' Friendly Association），
目的是加强彼此间的联系并保护共同利益。
然而，组织者表现出极少的热情，加上
日本人试图争取某些
记者支持他们的事业，该协会未能
成立。

在此次受挫后，《大美报》记者张翰（Chang Tse Yeu）
和《大美报》经理张似旭（Chang Che Shao）（后者
自该报置于同名的英国出版物管理之下后已失去影响力），
出于从中获取个人利益的愿望，主动发起
组织一个“记者俱乐部”。

他们成功聚集了一些国民政府成员、记者和
报纸编辑，并试图从国民政府获得补贴。该俱乐部原计划设在
律师张法先生（Chang Fah Yao）的办公室，地址为北门路16号众威大楼。

该俱乐部在努力引导报纸政策方面，令国民政府
大为满意。然而，报纸从业人员对这两名发起人的活动感到愤慨，拒绝加入该俱乐部。在总编辑 R. GOULD 先生因不明原因前往日本的消息传出后，《大美报》的态度变得可疑，

Subject Reported formation of a secret club by Chinese
newspaper owners.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen-ken Forwarded by

With reference to the attached translation of an
article entitled "Chinese Newspapers form a club" appearing
in the Shanghai Pictorial dated October 19, 1938, enquiries
made on the 5th floor of the Continental Emporium Building,
Nanking Road, have failed to locate a secret club alleged to
have been formed by the managements of various foreign owned
Chinese language newspapers, under the cloak of the "China
Insurance Year Book Publishing Society". It has been
found, however, that there is such a publishing society and
it is situated in Room 504, 5th floor, Chung Hai Bank Building,
16 Rue de la Porte du Nord, Mr. Sung Iai-chung (沈雷春),
private secretary to Mr. Chang Szu-hsu (張如旭) of the
"Tai Mei Pao" as mentioned in the said news article, being
in charge of affairs. This society has been in existence
for four years.

Regarding the alleged formation of a club by
newspaper managements, discreet enquiries show that Mr. Chang
Szu-hsu and his secretary Mr. Sung Iai-chung have the
intention of establishing a club for the managements of
various foreign owned Chinese language newspapers with a
view to promoting mutual friendship, but to date nothing
material has been done.

Kao Yen-ken
D. S. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

主题：据报道中国报业主组建秘密俱乐部。

由特科督察高延根（Kao Yen-ken）制作。由 转呈

关于附译的题为《中国报纸组建俱乐部》的文章，该文刊登于1938年10月19日的《上海画报》，经在南京路大陆商场大楼5楼进行调查，未能找到据称由各家外商拥有的中文报纸管理层以“中国保险年鉴社”为幌子组建的秘密俱乐部。然而，调查发现确实存在这样一个出版社，其位于北门路16号中海银行大楼5楼504室，由《大美报》张如旭先生（Chang Szu-hsu，原文如此，前文为张似旭）的私人秘书沈雷春先生（Sung Iai-chung）负责事务，正如上述新闻报道中所提及。该社已存在四年。

关于据称由报纸管理层组建俱乐部一事，谨慎的调查表明，张如旭先生及其秘书沈雷春先生有意为各家外商拥有的中文报纸的管理层建立一个俱乐部，以促进相互友谊，但迄今为止未采取任何实质性行动。

高延根
特科督察

特科副总监。
F. A. 致 特科副总监

第 2957/1 号，日期为 1938 年 10 月 14 日。

主题：建立记者俱乐部。

据称，上海各大报纸在日本人的压力下，一直考虑成立一个“文化界联欢会”，旨在加强彼此间的联系并保护共同利益。然而，由于组织者热情不高，且日本人正试图拉拢某些记者为其效力，该协会未能成立。

受挫之后，《大美报》记者张志翰（Jhang Tae Yeu）和《大美报》经理张似旭（Chang Che Shao）（后者在该报置于同名的英方出版物管理之下后已失去影响力），出于谋取个人私利的动机，主动发起组织一个“记者俱乐部”。

他们成功聚集了一些国民政府成员、记者和报纸编辑，并试图从国民政府获得补贴。俱乐部原计划设在北苏州路 16 号中汇大楼律师张法尧（Chang Fah Yao）先生的办公室内。

该俱乐部因致力于引导报纸的舆论导向，深得国民政府欢心。然而，新闻界人士对两名发起人的活动感到愤慨，拒绝加入该俱乐部。在《大美报》总编辑 R. GOULD 先生因不明原因前往日本的消息传出后，《大美报》的立场变得可疑。

张似旭甚至邀请记者们共进晚餐，以解释《大美报》的立场，并否认 R. GOULD 先生出行的消息。然而，他的解释徒劳无功，拟议中的俱乐部组织最终流产。

此类组织或许仍在酝酿之中，但有理由相信，其目前仅处于构想阶段。
